title: Installation of the External Bonded Doubler Strap on the Fwd Lower Shell Lap Joint

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Installation of the external bonded doubler strap on the forward lower shell lap joint, including the surface preparation, the adhesive cure cycle and the oversize fastener installation sequence.

sections.purpose: This task installs the external bonded doubler strap on the forward lower shell lap joint between stations 1080 and 1360 on one side of the aircraft, after removal or after an approved repair of the underlying joint.
sections.job_setup_note: The joint must have passed the eddy current inspection before this task starts. The adhesive film has a limited out-of-freezer life; record the time it leaves the freezer and do not exceed the working life given on the roll label. Surface preparation and bonding must be done in one continuous operation, so plan the shift accordingly. The chromate-free surface protection process must be available at the site.
sections.procedure: 1. Confirm from the technical log that the eddy current inspection of the joint has been done and that the joint was found serviceable. 2. Abrade the bonding surface of the skin and of the strap MOD50333-97 to the finish stated in the referenced repair data. CAUTION: DO NOT TOUCH THE ABRADED SURFACES WITH BARE HANDS. USE CLEAN GLOVES. 3. Clean the surfaces with the approved solvent and let them dry fully. 4. Apply the chromate-free surface protection to all bare metal. 5. Ream the fastener holes to the first oversize using the drill jig. 6. Do an eddy current inspection of each reamed hole. 7. Take the adhesive film from the freezer and let it reach room temperature in its sealed bag. 8. Apply the film to the strap and position the strap using the two locating pins. 9. Install the heater blanket and the vacuum bag and apply the cure cycle. WARNING: DO NOT LEAVE THE HEATER BLANKET WITHOUT SUPERVISION AT ANY TIME DURING THE CURE. 10. Let the assembly cool below 40 degrees before you remove the bag. 11. Install the rivets AES645587-2A wet with sealant, working from the centre of the strap outwards. 12. Do a tap test over the full strap area and mark any disbond. 13. Restore the fairing compound and the paint scheme to aerodynamic smoothness class B.
sections.close_out: Do a general visual inspection of the strap perimeter and confirm that the sealant fillet is continuous. Remove the locating pins and fill the two holes with the fasteners supplied. Remove the tooling and the waste material. Record the installation, the adhesive batch number and the cure chart in the aircraft technical record.

safety_precautions: Put the aircraft on jacks and install the ground locks.
Do not leave the heater blanket without supervision.
Use clean gloves when you handle abraded bonding surfaces.
Make sure that the area is ventilated during solvent use.

tooling.description: Drill jig, lap joint fastener pattern
